citations.claim: At first violating step 46 pole has fallen to 0.931 rad and system energy has grown to ~25.26 from ~1.09 initial, showing noise-driven destabilization
One step before, energy already ~24.34 with pole at 0.776 rad, showing rapid growth into violation

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.016349396823745244 to 0 keeping all else identical for same 46 steps; failure disappears, so seeded measurement noise is causal

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and ample force headroom (force ~10 vs limit 67.6) but sensor_noise ~0.016. Noisy angle/rate measurements cause state-feedback controller to apply incorrect forces that pump energy (E ~1.09 to ~25.26, external work ~24.17) instead of stabilizing, so pole angle diverges from -0.05 to 0.93 rad by step 46 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise alone restores stability.
vision_note: The cart remains near the center of the track while the pole leans increasingly to the right across steps 43 to 45. At step 46 the pole tip turns red, indicating the pole has exceeded the upright limit.
